description: Use when asked "does cannabis help with ...". Conditions on the Greencyclepedia evidence ladder (substantial, moderate, limited, insufficient, evidence of no benefit): the grade and why, the systematic reviews and trials behind it by PubMed identifier, the compounds and body structures involved and the Greencyclepedia page. Also 8 risk topics (pregnancy, suicide, driving ...), answered as risk research with the reviews behind them and no grade (no trials sit behind a risk topic; some list trials that test a cannabis medicine, kept apart from the risk research). Trials are kept as administered in each trial; doses are left out on purpose. Educational reference, not medical advice. Not a diagnostic or dosing tool. Example arguments: {"query":"sleep"}.

grade.description: Only conditions with this evidence grade.

query.description: Part of a condition name, for example "epilepsy", "pain" or "sleep". Leave out to list all.

name: search_conditions
title: Search conditions by evidence grade
